annotations.title: Check whether there is enough data to act

description: Decide whether a live campaign has produced enough data to justify pausing it, scaling its budget, rotating a creative or switching bidding strategy, and whether it is still inside the platform's learning phase. Returns the unmet requirements with the shortfall and an estimate of how long to wait. Call it before recommending any change and before calling a metric good or bad. For a verdict on a cost per acquisition or return on ad spend use 'judge_metric'; for a verdict on a click-through rate or conversion rate use 'judge_rate_metric', which is gated on clicks rather than conversions.

conversions.description: Conversions recorded so far. Omit it if it was not measured; do not pass 0 for unknown, because zero conversions after real traffic is a finding.

days_running.description: Days the campaign has been delivering.

platform.description: Ad platform. Known keys: google, google_display, google_search, linkedin, meta, microsoft, tiktok.

spend.description: Amount spent so far, in USD.

name: check_decision_readiness
